title: Structural conditions on trust-region radius updates. Part II: second-order convergence and asymptotic radius behaviour
summary: Continuing Part I (arXiv:2606.30202), we ask not which structural conditions on $\{Δ_k\}$ suffice for global convergence but what the radius does; the answers separate the mechanisms by whether the radius is tied to a criticality measure. We identify three asymptotic regimes: the criticality-anchored rules give $\sum_k Δ_k^2/M_k \overlineκ$ or $\overlineμ > \overlineκ$, with $\overlineκ$ a constant of the solution that cannot be checked in advance.
